preconditions.description: The number of rounds k is between 1 and 18, inclusive.
The string s has a length of 2^k - 1 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in s is either '0', '1', or '?'.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= 2**k - 1 and c in '01?' for p, c in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query p and c is within the specified range and character set.

postconditions.description: The output for each query is the number of possible winners of the tournament after the corresponding update to s.
